description: This Java class 'UomWorker' provides utility methods for handling units of measure (UOM), including conversions between different time units and a service call for UOM conversion.

classes.name: UomWorker
classes.description: Final utility class for unit of measure operations, including time conversions and UOM value conversions.

methods.name: uomTimeToCalTime
methods.description: Converts a UOM ID to a corresponding Calendar field and multiplier for time calculations.

methods.name: addUomTime
methods.description: Adds a specified UOM time value to a Calendar object, optionally starting from a given Timestamp.

methods.name: convertUom
methods.description: Converts a BigDecimal value from one UOM to another using a service call.
